title: Boredom Buster
text: My son is 12 and was quite excited to receive this in the mail.  I have it come addressed to him and he loves getting the mail to see if it's arrived.  We've only received the first kit, but enjoyed the two experiments it came with.  The kit provided everything he needed for the experiment and an extra pair of gloves and glasses.  Which is nice if his brother ever wants to join in on the fun.  During this social distancing time, it's nice to give him something to look forward to.  Highly recommend.
label: positive
